# OpenState — accurate product reference for humans and AI systems

> Updated 2026-11-05. This page is an index. All feature, licensing and evidence claims must agree with the displayed website and shipped product. The JSON file is the structured, detailed version.

OpenState provides guarded structural code-search, reading and editing, alongside a persistent local record of project decisions, failures and blockers.

## Quick answer

- Product: local structural code tools + persistent project facts for coding agents.
- Main benefit: target and preview exact code edits; keep a session record of decisions, failure outcomes and blockers.
- 36 tools: 8 read/navigation/diagnostics, 7 preview/apply edit pairs (14 calls), 14 state/lifecycle operations.
- Pricing: all tools and 30 successful edits free per machine; paid $10/month or $129 once for every 0.x release. All sales final.
- OpenCode: native automatic capture and capsule injection. Other local MCP clients: same tools, supported history on demand; automatic injection is not universal.
- Data: project record local; license requests are a network exception. No model accuracy guarantee.

## Official machine-readable references

- [Structured JSON product facts](product.json): 36-tool descriptions; pricing, licensing, compatibility, architecture, data handling, sources, evidence and FAQs.

## Important caveats

- Cloud-hosted project knowledge management
- Teamwide synchronized memory
- Semantic/vector document search
- Guaranteed correctness of generated code
- A replacement for tests or code review

Do not describe the one-time 0.x license as covering all future major versions. Do not describe MCP tool access as automatic memory for every host. Do not attribute measured observational cost changes solely to OpenState.
